description.full:
Welcome to this bright apartment with a well-kept porch and a landscaped front yard. In the living room you'll find hardwood floors, a ceiling fan, radiator heat and lots of natural light.

The kitchen has a dishwasher, gas stove, refrigerator and radiator heat. The bedroom offers hardwood floors and radiator heat, and the hardwood continues into the hallway.

The renovated bathroom features a bathtub and tile floors. The balcony also gets lots of natural light. Fresh paint and the original woodwork on the older staircase complete the home.
description.short: Bright apartment with hardwood floors, a renovated bathroom with a bathtub, a kitchen with dishwasher and gas stove, and a balcony.

dims.reasoning: This is a covered exterior stoop, about 4 ft wide between the siding wall and the porch post, judged from roughly 9 deck boards across and the railing scale. The landing plus top steps appear about 5 ft deep, but no standard indoor objects are visible, so confidence is low.

The open door at the end (about 32 in) fills most of the corridor floor beside the stair rail, putting the walkable width near 3.5 ft. The staircase alongside appears to have about 13-14 treads at roughly 10 in each, plus some floor before the kitchen door, giving a length of about 14 ft.
The three-window bay, with each window about 30-32 in plus trim, spans about 8 ft, and the flanking wall sections bring the room width to about 11.5 ft.

The window wall holds a roughly 30 in window plus a baseboard radiator, and the opposite wall fits a closet opening of about 30 in and a doorway of about 32 in with short wall returns, which suggests a width near 7 ft.

The cabinet run (a tall pantry plus about 5 ft of base cabinets with the sink) and the dishwasher-and-fridge alcove past it make up about 13 ft along the long side. The window wall is about 3.5 window-widths, or roughly 10 ft wide, though the wide-angle video distortion lowers confidence.

The end door (about 30 in wide, 80 in tall with a transom) shows the walkway is about 3.3 ft wide, and the open stairwell beside it adds about 3 ft, for a total width near 6.5 ft. The run from the foreground landing to the end door looks like roughly 4–5 door-widths of floor, giving a length near 11.5 ft.

The window wall is about 2.5 window-trim widths across (trim is about 38-40 in), which gives roughly 8-9 ft. The side walls run noticeably longer in the wide shots, and the door sits near the window wall, which suggests about 10-11 ft of depth.

The back wall holds the toilet space (~28 in), a ~24 in vanity and the 30 in tub end, giving about 5.5 ft of width. The 60 in tub runs along the right wall, and the door and entry zone add about 3 ft, giving roughly 8 ft of length.

About 20 balusters at roughly 4 in spacing span the main railing between posts, giving a length of about 7-8 ft. Roughly 10-11 deck boards of about 5.5 in each run from the camera to the railing, giving a depth of about 5 ft.
